notes.title: Patch notes: V1.0.5.1
notes.notes:
Patch time!

Patchnotes version 1.0.5.1:

- Fixed false error in level 40 making the real last error not clickable

Discord link: https://discord.gg/WTQvaY5D6t

notes.title: Patch notes: V1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello here, patch time again?
Yes! we had still some work to do on optimization and I think we reached our goal: the game seems to work most of the hardware configurations we've met. Please keep telling us if it's not the case on your computer! Here's the discord link again: https://discord.gg/WTQvaY5D6t

Patchnotes version 1.0.5:

- big work on optimization / fixing levels not loading on some low-end hardware, again!
- fix on Twitch mode, bits prices has been fixed and events sent during loading are kept for the next level
- fix on some levels

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Patchnote V1.0.4.1
notes.notes: Hey it's me again! Quick hotfix because level 4-9 was buggy! Prepare for more hotfixes maybe, There were a lot of changes so bugs could have slip throught the net!

notes.title: Patch notes: V1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello here, finally patch time!
We worked a lot to improve performances and loading time, and on optimization in general. There's still work to do, but it's already better. I think crash on level loading are fixed now. Please continue to report on the Steam discussions or on our Discord if you encounter any troubles: 
https://discord.gg/WTQvaY5D6t

We are currently testing MacOs version and it should be back later this day! 

Patchnotes version 1.0.4:

- big work on optimization / fixing levels not loading on some low-end hardware
- fixed some layers gaps
- fixed music starting twice if you quit a level during the victory sound
- fixed a bug with the help button having particles even if it was not clickable
- idle camera animation is less frequent now

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Patch notes: V1.0.3.1
notes.notes:
Hello, long time no see, eh? 
Just a small hotfix for a bug causing a lot of trouble to gamepad's (and consequently, Steam Deck's) players. Sorry about that.

Also, I removed hints-related achievements as they were not funny. Play at your own pace, we said! 

see ya!

Patchnotes version 1.0.3.1:

- HOTFIX Fixed home button disapearing when pressing A from the gamepad or Enter from the keyboard
- removed hints-related achievements

notes.title: Patch notes: V1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello, it's patch time!
We are still working on the 2 mains issues: levels loading crashing the game, and the MacOS version. Thank you for your patience! 

Patch notes version 1.0.3:

- Optimization attempt
- Fixed hint circle position for real
- Fixed some level left/right desynchronization
- Fixed issue where next biome would not unlock
- Fixed issue where you could launch levels not on the selection menu
- Bits in Twitch mode get more effects, starting from 50 bits
- Translated defaut Twitch keyword
- Enhanced logging to help debug level loading issues
- Increased the size of the erasing area when cleaning the screen
- Fixed a typo in options menu

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Patch notes: V1.0.2.1
notes.notes:
Patchnotes version 1.0.2.1:

- reverted the changes about hint circles position because it fixed for some differences but broke for others

notes.title: Patch notes: V1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello there,

here's the first official patch! (We did one hotfix durant launch day)

Here's the content, please note that some other known topics are still under work:

Version 1.0.2:

- added a version number in the main menu!
- fixed hint circle placement on some levels
- fix white arrow from the tutorial that stays on screen sometimes in level 1
- fix weird shadow on the upper right corner of the screen on very high resolution
- Added a missing capital letters in the spanish version of the options menu
- fixed something on a secret...
- fixed another secret stuff...
- fixed an issue where players were missing the ending 
- fixed issues with musics playback
- Twitch Settings are now properly loaded and saved
- fixed missing gold achievements problem
- fixed graphical bug with hint button highlight

Don't hesitate to bug report on the Steam community hub or on our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/WTQvaY5D6t

Have a good day!

notes.title: MacOS version withdrawal
notes.notes:
⚠️⚙️ Folks, we are aware of the big crashes issues on launch regarding the MAC OS build of Broken Lens.  We are deeply sorry about that.

Please note that our dev is on it and trying his best to find a solution and fix this. 

For now we decided to withdraw it temporarily from the Steam Store and we'll keep you updated.

We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience.

MacOS user, whenever you got a crash or not, please come to our Discord to share your Hardware and Software configuration:
https://discord.gg/WTQvaY5D6t
